newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla cattle trading active, few $67 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla cattle trading active, few $67 - USDA.

text.p: Trade active in the panhandle area Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 25,000 head slaughter steers and 17,600 heifers; 68,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,900 head formulated and 300 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 66.00-66.25, few North Plains 67.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 66.00-66.25, few North Plains 67.00. Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs including heiferettes 61.00-64.00.
Confirmed 42,600 Week Ago 36,300 Year Ago None
Wk to Date 68,900 Week Ago 51,100 Year Ago 13,600
